I am a 63-year-old woman farming 1.22 hectares in Salima. Through the government's fertilizer subsidy program, I was able to get two bags of fertilizer this year, which I will put on my maize plot. I will also plant the hybrid seed they gave me. I do not have money for pesticides or irrigation, and at my age it is hard to carry manure, so I will not use those. My children and grandchildren will help me with the work, but I may need to hire a few young men when it is time to clear the land and harvest.
